```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(mvtnorm)
library(pracma)
library(here)

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))
```

The purpose of this notebook is to generate draws from a multi-output spectral mixture Gaussian process with known hyperparameter values:

- $w_i$: magnitude/weight
- $\Sigma_i$: spectral width/variance
- $\mu_i$: spectral frequency/mean
- $\theta_i$: delay
- $\phi_i$: phase


```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 1

n_points_per_band <- 150
max_attempts <- 500

pct_missing <- 0.3
noise_sigma <- 0.1

i <- 1
errored <- TRUE
output <- NULL

while (i <= max_attempts && errored) {
  seed <- round(runif(1, min = 0, max = 99999))
  errored <- tryCatch(
    {
      output <- simulate_D2Q1phi0_moskgp(
        tstart = 0,
        tend = 1,
        n_per_band = n_points_per_band, 
        noise_sigma = noise_sigma, 
        seed = seed, 
        masked_pct = pct_missing 
      )
      cat( paste0("Completed: i = ", i, ", Seed = ", seed, "\t *** \t\n") )
      FALSE
    },
    warning = function(cnd) {
      cat( paste0("Warning: i = ", i, ", Seed = ", seed, " \"", conditionMessage(cnd), "\"\r") )
      TRUE
    },
    finally = {
      i <- i + 1
    }
  )
}
if (i > max_attempts && is.null(output)) {
  cat("Maximum attempts reached:", i - 1, "\n")
}

output_params <- output[[1]]
output_df <- output[[2]]
output_params
```

```{r}
cat("w_12 =", w_12 <- output_params$w[1]*output_params$w[2] * 
      exp( -pi^2*(output_params$mu[1]-output_params$mu[2])^2 * (output_params$Sigma[1]+output_params$Sigma[2])^-1 ) )
cat("\nSigma_12 =", Sigma_12 <- 2*output_params$Sigma[1] * (output_params$Sigma[1] + output_params$Sigma[2])^-1 * output_params$Sigma[2])
cat("\nmu_12 =", mu_12 <- (output_params$Sigma[1] + output_params$Sigma[2])^-1 * 2*pi * (output_params$Sigma[1]*output_params$mu[2] + output_params$Sigma[2]*output_params$mu[1]))
cat("\ntheta_12 =", theta_12 <- output_params$theta[1] - output_params$theta[2])
cat("\nalpha_12 =", alpha_12 <- w_12*sqrt( 2*pi * Sigma_12 ) )
```

$$k_{ij}(\tau) = \alpha_{ij} \exp\left( -\frac{1}{2} (\tau + \theta_{ij})^2 \Sigma_{ij}\right) \cos\left[ (\tau + \theta_{ij})\mu_{ij}\right]$$

```{r}
data.frame(
  tau = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.001)
) |> 
  mutate(k12  = alpha_12 * exp(-0.5 * (tau + theta_12)^2 * Sigma_12) * cos( (tau + theta_12) * mu_12 ) ) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = tau, y = k12) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -theta_12, colour = "red")

```

```{r}
output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = f, colour = d) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = paste0("Seed = ", output_params$seed, 
                     ", mu = ", output_params$mu[1], 
                     ", theta = ", output_params$theta[2]), 
       alpha = "Observed", colour = "Band") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```





```{r}
output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, alpha = ifelse(masked, 0.2, 1), colour = d) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_rug(sides = "b", position = "jitter") +
  labs(title = paste("Seed =", output_params$seed), alpha = "Observed", colour = "Band") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
str(output_df)
```

```{r}
output_filename_stub <- glue("D{D}-Q{Q}-seed{seed}-n{n_points_per_band*D}-mnar{pct_missing}-sigma{noise_sigma}")

df_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-sim.csv")
param_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-param.tsv")

write_csv(
  output_df |>
    filter(!masked) |> 
    select(-masked), 
  here("data", df_output_filename)
)

write_tsv(
  output_params, 
  here("data", param_output_filename)
)
```
